content:
maria: Queue alert  3 docs PRs blocked on review + merge. Preview for one is stale and linkcheck is failing intermittently. Need quick assignment.
jon: list the PR ids?
maria: #2611 (python sdk backport for v0.8 snippet), #2615 (migration example: dedicated deployment), #2617 (auth page dead links).
kevin: I can own #2611 and run the snippet locally. heads-up: it touches the legacy import path.
maria: thanks. @kevin can you also confirm whether the snippet should use `from redwood import Client` or `from redwood.sdk import Client`? our pytests expect the latter.
kevin: will verify. If tests expect `redwood.sdk`, we'll update snippet and add a short backward-compat note.
doc-rotation-leads: noted. assigning a backup reviewer for today since primary on rotation missed ping.
maria: added label `docs-review:urgent` to all three PRs and pinged the rotation leads.
deploy-bot: deploy-preview for #2611: https://deploy-preview-2611--docs.redwood.example/ ; linkcheck: 2 failures (external auth guide slow).
jon: For #2615 migration example, can someone confirm the table row about kv-cache TTL? I think the numbers changed after the runtime update.
kevin: I'll check runtime change log. If it did change, we should update the table and add a short footnote `as of runtime v1.8`.
maria: Quick reviewer checklist proposal (paste to PRs):
```
- open deploy-preview link
- sanity-run any CLI/snippet commands in a venv
- verify snippet import paths match sdk-tests
- validate tables (units and footnotes)
- click through auth links that CI flagged (manual if needed)
```
jon: doing manual link checks while CI is flaky is fine. If linkcheck rate limits, comment `linkcheck:manual-verified` on the PR so merges can be unblocked.
kevin: I ran the #2611 snippet with py3.11 in a clean venv. Import needs `redwood.sdk`. Also updated example to use `Client.from_env()` per new config pattern. Pushed a tiny fix.
maria: thanks! can you add a one-line migration note at top: "Note: legacy import `redwood` will continue to work until v1.0, prefer `redwood.sdk`"
kevin: added.
doc-rotation-leads: please add a short process note: when a reviewer is OOO, assign a backup in the rotation doc and escalate to eng-docs-oncall if unassigned after 4h.
maria: added that to the rotation README (PR link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/compare/rotation-readme-update).
jon: (reaction) :thumbsup:
jon: I merged #2617 (auth link fixes) after manual check.
maria: great. #2615 and #2611 pending final thumbs. If CI still flakey tomorrow we can allow `linkcheck:manual-verified` label and let releases team merge after QA.
kevin: leaving one inline nit on #2611 about newline in fenced code. not blocking.
maria: ok. setting reminder in rotation calendar to temporarily add an extra reviewer slot for migration examples this week.
deploy-bot: CI rerun scheduled for #2611 at 2026-03-22T09:45:00Z.
maria: thanks everyone. tagging follow-up: add a short blurb in the docs-contrib guide about how to do a manual smoke test when deploy-preview is stale.
deploy-bot: thread closed due to inactivity after 2h.
